items.title: Earl May interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2001
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer conducting the session with Earl May. There is no evidence in the text of a prior personal or professional relationship between Earl May and Monk Rowe beyond this interview context.

ctx.x: Earl was interviewed in New York City on January 11, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in New York City filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Earl May with me today. You know you have a lot of people who say nice things about you, did you know that?
Really? No I didn’t know that.
